findings.title: Delivery-only recovery records the delivery but never re-opens the lane (finalize's flipJobToWorking is skipped)
findings.detail: This branch (silas.rebrief landed, delivery missing) records the delivery and clears markers but skips flipJobToWorking, which finalizeRebriefRequest always runs. If the crash hit between the rebrief append and the flip, the lane stays in-review/delivered, diverging from the canonical path.
findings.recommended_fix: Call flipJobToWorking in this branch before clearing the markers, or route it through finalizeRebriefRequest so both recovery paths share one recording path.

findings.title: finalizeRebriefRequest clears every pending marker for the job, letting an older request consume a newer request's markers
findings.detail: beginPendingRebrief upserts fresh ids for a newer request; finalize instead clears whatever rows exist for the job. An older request settling after a retry therefore wipes the newer request's markers, so a later mid-turn crash loses it silently.
findings.recommended_fix: Pass the marker ids captured from beginPendingRebrief (and the claimed group's ids in recovery) into finalize and clear only those, or compare payloadHash before consuming rows.

findings.title: resolveResumeFile picks the first listed minion, not the 'latest' the comment promises
findings.detail: The comment says the fallback is 'the job's latest minion', but .find returns the first match in listAgents() order. If listAgents is oldest-first, recovery resumes a stale session (e.g. the original dispatcher's) instead of the interrupted worker's.
findings.recommended_fix: Pick the newest matching minion (iterate listAgents() keeping the last match, or filter then at(-1)); a non-latest pick can resume an unrelated stale session.

findings.title: Dead fallback `?? group[0]` in the delivery-only recovery anchor
findings.detail: This branch runs only when every missing marker is job.delivered and missing is non-empty, so group always holds a delivery marker and find cannot return undefined; the ?? fallback and the anchor?. optional chain are dead.
findings.recommended_fix: Drop the unreachable fallback (and optional chaining), or add an explicit invariant check, so the code states the guaranteed-non-empty group.
